about_short_description.short_description: Wingspan is the first payroll platform for contingent work—automating onboarding, payments, 1099s, and contractor benefits

product.name: Contractor Onboarding
product.description: A platform feature that streamlines contractor onboarding and eligibility verification, including W-9 collection and compliance checks.

product.name: Payments Automation
product.description: Automates invoicing, payment calculations, and disbursements to contractors with support for multiple payment methods and schedules.

product.name: 1099 Tax Compliance Management
product.description: Manages the creation, filing, and delivery of 1099-NEC tax forms for contractors, including error correction and secure submission to the IRS.

product.name: Contractor Benefits Administration
product.description: Provides contractors access to financial tools, business checking accounts, debit cards, and curated insurance options without adding classification risk.

product.name: Contractor Verification and Compliance Controls
product.description: Includes background checks, eSignature capabilities, and ongoing compliance monitoring to ensure contractor eligibility and policy adherence.

product.name: Contractor Help Desk
product.description: A dedicated support service for contractors addressing questions related to benefits, taxes, payments, and compliance.
